verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an explicit bulk-operation feature. The closest evidence is automatic processing across many items: the whole inbox gets triaged with labels and every email needing a reply gets a draft, and routines run a whole recurring job on autopilot once a schedule or trigger is set. Missing for 10: an explicit user-directed bulk action capability (select or apply across many items at once), documentation of batch limits or behavior, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
